name: evaluation_id
description: Evaluation run id this metric belongs to; joins to evaluation_data_history.evaluation_id.

name: evaluated_at
description: Evaluation start time; partition key.

name: table_name
description: Table this metric was computed for.

name: landing_table
description: Destination table FQN the metric was computed against.

name: source_table
description: Source table FQN the metric was computed against.

name: level
description: Metric level (e.g. column, table, pair, dataset).

name: family
description: Metric family within the catalogue (e.g. univariate, correlation, privacy).

name: metric_id
description: Catalogue metric id.

name: metric_version
description: Catalogue metric version that computed this row.

name: value_kind
description: distance | share | ratio | bits | correlation_delta | auc | score | count

name: column_name
description: Column this metric is scoped to, if column-level.

name: column_name_2
description: Second column, for pairwise (e.g. correlation) metrics.

name: column_kind
description: Declared kind of column_name (e.g. categorical, numeric, free_text).

name: edge
description: FK edge this metric is scoped to, if relationship-level (e.g. child.col->parent.col).

name: value
description: The metric's computed value.

name: source_value
description: Value of the underlying statistic computed on the source.

name: synthetic_value
description: Value of the underlying statistic computed on the synthetic table.

name: baseline_value
description: metric(R, source): the floor a perfect copier of the reference sample scores

name: score
description: Normalized score derived from value (0-1, higher is better).

name: status
description: pass | warn | fail | info | not_evaluated

name: threshold_warn
description: Value at which status becomes warn.

name: threshold_fail
description: Value at which status becomes fail.

name: noise_floor
description: Minimum value attributable to sampling noise rather than a real difference.

name: noise_floor_method
description: Method used to estimate noise_floor.

name: ci_low
description: Lower bound of the metric's confidence interval.

name: ci_high
description: Upper bound of the metric's confidence interval.

name: n_source
description: Number of source rows/values the metric was computed over.

name: n_synthetic
description: Number of synthetic rows/values the metric was computed over.

name: method
description: exact | binned | sketch | sample | value_sampled

name: sample_rate
description: Fraction of rows sampled to compute this metric.

name: encoding_plan_digest
description: Digest of the column-encoding plan used for this metric.

name: feature_set_digest
description: Digest of the feature set used for this metric (e.g. correlation-matrix columns).

name: detail
description: Metric-specific structured detail (e.g. Chao-Shen coverage detail).
